searchText: **Call in ~15 minutes,** hosted by yours truly 👋 Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/439 Stream: https://youtu.be/SKPQSR9CD24 Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/91725886939?pwd=b2kzT0JGeFAzTmhyb1BYSTgrZ0xwdz09 Quick notes from the call: https://hackmd.io/@benjaminion/HyxWQTdqY Apologies, but I think I messed up the stream for today 😦 ACD automatically streams to YT whenever I start streaming on OBS, but the CL calls require you to manually "turn on" the stream on YT, which I didn't do. If we're lucky, the zoom meeting was auto-recorded (it's Danny's so waiting on him to confirm) 🤞 Sorry, no zoom recording 😦 Will fix the settings for next time. Thank you yet again for this! Given that there's no recording, I wonder what is meant by the "shadow fork" that <@360491619402776577> is working on? We sync goerli on a couple of nodes and deploy a deposit contract, then we fork our nodes (beacon and el) off the main network. Thus goerli will keep going, while we are on our "shadow forked" chain on PoS. We can then replay transactions from the real chain on our "private" chain Oh that's great!
